title: Check your understanding: Sparse Index and Large Monorepos

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the purpose of sparse index and large monorepos?
options: Sparse index can reduce index overhead for sparse worktrees, but compatibility depends on Git version and tools that inspect repository state. Confirm the current documentation and validate the workflow before broad rollout.
Git automatically backs up every file, including ignored and untracked files, to a remote.
The operation grants every contributor write access to the hosted repository.
questions.answer_key: Sparse index can reduce index overhead for sparse worktrees, but compatibility depends on Git version and tools that inspect repository state. Confirm the current documentation and validate the workflow before broad rollout.
